items.title: A systematic review of current evidence on clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques in sacroiliac joint dysfunction.
items.summary: This systematic review aims to evaluate the clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques for sacroiliac joint dysfunction (SIJD), with studies published between January 2021 and December 2025.
items.curatedReason: 虽然 PROSPERO 注册和 PRISMA 流程预示研究质量，但目前这篇系统综述仍在进行中，尚未发布最终结果。在证据发布前，请勿依据此预告改变临床实践。

items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述旨在评估腰骶部翻滚和改良 SIMS 手法治疗骶髂关节功能障碍 (SIJD) 的临床结局，涵盖 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月发表的研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: While the PROSPERO registration and PRISMA adherence suggest a high-quality review, this systematic review is currently in progress, and no final results have been published yet. Do not alter clinical practice based on this pre-announcement.

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
items.summary: A cluster randomized clinical trial found that a Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA), integrating prognostic risk stratification with digital health, was cost-effective compared to usual physiotherapy for 136 patients with neck and/or shoulder pain.
items.curatedReason: 分层融合物理治疗（结合风险分层和数字健康）在颈肩痛患者中，不仅临床效果不劣于常规物理治疗，成本效益也更好。这意味着你可以开始考虑在临床实践中更积极地整合基于风险分层的数字健康工具，尤其是在资源有限的初级诊疗环境。
items.titleZh: 分层融合物理治疗结合数字健康对颈肩痛的成本效益：一项整群随机临床试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项整群随机临床试验评估了分层融合物理治疗（SBPA，结合预后风险分层与数字健康）与常规物理治疗相比，对 136 名颈肩痛患者的成本效益。结果显示 SBPA 具有成本效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stratified blended physiotherapy (combining risk stratification with digital health) for neck and shoulder pain is not only clinically non-inferior to usual physiotherapy but also more cost-effective. This suggests you can start considering more active integration of risk-stratified digital health tools into your practice, especially in resource-limited primary care settings.
items.limitation: 本研究的患者样本量相对较小，且仅在荷兰初级诊疗环境进行，结果的外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The relatively small patient sample size and its focus on a primary care setting in the Netherlands may limit the generalizability of these findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Positive Psychology Interventions for Adults with Spinal Cord Injury: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of eight studies published between 2000 and 2025 indicated that positive psychology interventions (PPIs) may improve health and well-being outcomes in adults with spinal cord injury.
items.curatedReason: 积极心理学干预对脊髓损伤患者的心理健康和幸福感有潜在益处。虽然证据仍在早期阶段，你可以关注这类非传统干预，作为全面康复计划的辅助手段，尤其是在患者心理调适方面。
items.titleZh: 积极心理学干预对脊髓损伤成人患者的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和 Meta 分析纳入了 2000 年至 2025 年间发表的 8 项研究，旨在评估积极心理学干预（PPIs）对脊髓损伤（SCI）成人患者健康和幸福结局的影响，结果提示 PPIs 可能带来改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Positive psychology interventions show potential benefits for mental health and well-being in adults with spinal cord injury. While evidence is still emerging, you can consider these non-traditional interventions as adjuncts to comprehensive rehabilitation plans, especially for psychological adjustment.
items.limitation: 纳入的试验数量较少（8项），且干预措施和结果指标可能存在异质性，影响汇总结果的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (8) and potential heterogeneity in interventions and outcome measures may affect the robustness of the pooled results.

items.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An individualized swimming and education program, delivered via telehealth, significantly improved disability in adults with chronic non-specific low back pain at 8 weeks compared to education alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实，个体化游泳和教育方案在改善慢性下腰痛患者残疾方面优于单独教育。下次遇到慢性 LBP 患者，特别是那些喜欢水上活动的，可以把这个方案作为强有力的循证推荐。
items.titleZh: 个体化游泳与教育方案治疗慢性下腰痛的有效性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项通过远程医疗提供的个体化游泳与教育方案，在 8 周时显著改善了慢性非特异性下腰痛成年患者的残疾程度，优于单独教育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that an individualized swimming and education program is superior to education alone for improving disability in chronic low back pain patients. For your chronic LBP patients, especially those who prefer aquatic activities, you now have strong evidence to recommend this program.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体的游泳和教育方案内容细节及远程物理治疗的效果。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report detailed content of the swimming and education program or the specific impact of telehealth physiotherapy.

items.title: Virtual Reality-assisted Physiotherapeutic Training for Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 5 RCTs found that virtual reality-assisted physiotherapy significantly improved pain (SMD = 0.40, 95% CI: 0.14-0.65), physical function (SMD = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.05-0.70), and balance (SMD = 0.44, 95% CI: 0.16-0.72) in patients with knee osteoarthritis compared to traditional rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实辅助物理治疗对膝骨关节炎的疼痛、功能和平衡有显著改善作用。面对传统方法效果不佳或患者依从性低的 KOA 患者，可以考虑将 VR 作为一种有价值的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助物理治疗对膝骨关节炎患者的疗效：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 5 项 RCT 的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，与传统康复相比，虚拟现实辅助物理治疗能显著改善膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛（SMD = 0.40）、身体功能（SMD = 0.37）和平衡（SMD = 0.44）。
items.curatedReasonEn: VR-assisted physiotherapy significantly improves pain, physical function, and balance in knee osteoarthritis. For KOA patients who respond poorly to traditional methods or have low adherence, consider VR as a valuable adjunct.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入 5 项 RCT，研究数量相对较少，可能影响结果的稳定性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only 5 RCTs, a relatively small number of studies, which may affect the robustness of the results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Association of combined physical and cognitive rehabilitation with post-stroke dementia: a U.S. multicenter retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: A U.S. multicenter retrospective cohort study of 958 propensity score-matched stroke patients (≥55 years) with mild cognitive impairment found that combined physical and cognitive rehabilitation was associated with a significantly reduced risk of post-stroke dementia (HR = 0.58, 95% CI: 0.44-0.78, P < 0.001) compared to physical rehabilitation alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项美国多中心回顾性队列研究提示，结合物理和认知康复可以降低卒中后痴呆的风险。在处理卒中后伴有轻度认知障碍的患者时，你应将认知康复纳入你的康复方案，以期获得更好的长期认知结局。
items.titleZh: 综合物理和认知康复与卒中后痴呆关联性：一项美国多中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 958 名经过倾向评分匹配的卒中患者（≥55 岁）进行的美国多中心回顾性队列研究发现，与单独进行物理康复相比，综合物理和认知康复与卒中后痴呆风险显著降低相关（HR = 0.58, 95% CI: 0.44-0.78, P < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This U.S. multicenter retrospective cohort study suggests that combined physical and cognitive rehabilitation can reduce the risk of post-stroke dementia. When managing stroke patients with mild cognitive impairment, you should integrate cognitive rehabilitation into your treatment plan for better long-term cognitive outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，虽然进行了倾向匹配，但仍无法完全排除混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study, despite propensity score matching, cannot entirely rule out the influence of confounding factors.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The RESOLVE Trial: A Stepped-Wedge, Cluster-Randomized Clinical Trial Evaluating the Effects of Clinical Practice Guidelines and Psychologically Informed Physical Therapy on Low Back Pain Outcomes in Service Members and Veterans.
items.summary: A stepped-wedge, cluster-randomized trial showed that implementing clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) alongside psychologically informed physical therapy (PIPT) significantly reduced low back pain-related disability and pain in military and veteran health care settings.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，将临床实践指南与心理知情物理治疗（PIPT）相结合的实施策略，在退伍军人和军人中能有效减少下腰痛相关残疾和疼痛。你可以参考其干预策略，优化你的 LBP 管理方案，尤其是在多学科背景下。
items.titleZh: RESOLVE 试验：评估临床实践指南与心理知情物理治疗对军人与退伍军人下腰痛结局影响的阶梯楔形、整群随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项阶梯楔形、整群随机试验显示，在军事和退伍军人医疗环境中，结合临床实践指南（CPGs）和心理知情物理治疗（PIPT）的实施策略，显著降低了下腰痛相关残疾和疼痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that implementing clinical practice guidelines combined with psychologically informed physical therapy (PIPT) effectively reduces low back pain-related disability and pain in service members and veterans. You can use this intervention strategy to optimize your LBP management, especially in multidisciplinary settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项在军事和退伍军人医疗机构进行的多中心研究，其结果可能不完全适用于普通民用诊所。
items.limitationEn: This was a multicenter study conducted in military and veteran healthcare settings, and its findings may not be fully generalizable to civilian clinics.

items.title: Long-term benefits of ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation for chronic lateral elbow pain: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blinded, sham-controlled trial with 49 participants found that ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation, combined with exercise, provided mid- and long-term benefits for chronic lateral elbow pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实，超声引导的经皮电神经刺激结合运动疗法，对慢性肱骨外上髁炎患者具有中长期益处。在处理传统方法效果不佳的网球肘时，你可以把这个作为一种有效的辅助方案。
items.titleZh: 超声引导经皮电神经刺激治疗慢性肱骨外上髁炎的长期益处：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 49 名参与者的随机、双盲、假对照试验发现，超声引导经皮电神经刺激结合运动疗法，对慢性肱骨外上髁炎具有中长期益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation combined with exercise offers mid- to long-term benefits for chronic lateral epicondylitis. When managing tennis elbow resistant to traditional methods, you can consider this an effective adjunctive treatment.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量为 49 名参与者，相对较小，可能需要更大规模的研究来进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study included 49 participants, which is relatively small and may require larger studies for further validation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Content validity, reliability, and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments of the modified bradykinesia rating scale (MBRS).
items.summary: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) demonstrated adequate content validity, excellent test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.94-0.97) and inter-rater reliability (ICC = 0.82-0.97), and good agreement between in-person and video-call assessments in individuals with Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 改良运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）在帕金森病评估中展现了良好的内容效度、重测信度和评定者间信度，并且现场评估和视频通话评估之间具有一致性。未来在帕金森病患者的远程评估中，你可以考虑使用 MBRS。
items.titleZh: 改良运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）的内容效度、信度及现场与视频通话评估的一致性研究
items.summaryZh: 改良运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）在帕金森病患者中表现出足够的内容效度、出色的重测信度（ICC = 0.94-0.97）和评定者间信度（ICC = 0.82-0.97），以及现场和视频通话评估之间良好的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) shows good content validity, test-retest reliability, and inter-rater reliability for Parkinson's disease assessment, with consistency between in-person and video-call assessments. You can consider using MBRS for remote assessment of Parkinson's patients in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究未提供 MBRS 在不同帕金森病分期或严重程度患者中的表现细节。
items.limitationEn: This study did not provide details on MBRS performance across different Parkinson's disease stages or severity levels.

items.title: In adult patients with brainstem strokes, does dysphagia rehabilitation improve health-related outcomes compared to usual care for inpatients? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies (443 participants) concluded that dysphagia rehabilitation, including traditional swallowing therapy and device inclusion, is effective for improving swallow function in inpatients with brainstem stroke.
items.curatedReason: 脑干卒中住院患者的吞咽困难康复是有效的。你应当积极采纳传统吞咽治疗或结合设备干预，这项包含443名患者的系统综述证实了这些方法的疗效。
items.titleZh: 脑干卒中成人患者吞咽困难康复是否比常规住院治疗更能改善健康相关结局？一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 12 项研究（443 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析得出结论，吞咽困难康复，包括传统吞咽治疗和设备辅助，能有效改善脑干卒中住院患者的吞咽功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: Dysphagia rehabilitation for inpatients with brainstem stroke is effective. You should confidently implement traditional swallowing therapy or device-assisted interventions, as this systematic review of 443 participants confirms their efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的 RCT 数量有限，且不同干预措施之间的比较受异质性影响。
items.limitationEn: The number of included RCTs is limited, and comparisons between different interventions are affected by heterogeneity.

items.title: A Multimodal Assessment of Gastric Motility, reflux risk, and Clinical Efficacy: Intermittent Oro-Esophageal versus Nasogastric Tube Feeding for Post-Stroke Dysphagia in a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-center RCT with 54 post-stroke dysphagia patients found that intermittent oro-esophageal tube feeding (IOE) was superior to nasogastric tube feeding (NG) for reducing gastric retention volume (40.5 ± 25.3 ml vs. 79.2 ± 36.1 ml, p < 0.001) and reflux risk (4.2% vs. 20.8%, p = 0.02) after 14 days, while supporting swallowing recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，间歇性口咽管饲法与鼻胃管饲法相比，在卒中后吞咽困难患者中减少了胃潴留和反流风险。在管理有吞咽困难的卒中患者时，你现在有证据支持考虑间歇性口咽管饲法作为一种替代选择，以优化胃肠道管理。
items.titleZh: 间歇性口咽管饲法与鼻胃管饲法治疗卒中后吞咽困难的多模态评估：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 54 名卒中后吞咽困难患者的单中心随机对照试验发现，在支持吞咽恢复的同时，间歇性口咽管饲法（IOE）在 14 天后在减少胃潴留量（40.5 ± 25.3 ml vs. 79.2 ± 36.1 ml, p < 0.001）和反流风险（4.2% vs. 20.8%, p = 0.02）方面优于鼻胃管饲法（NG）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that intermittent oro-esophageal tube feeding reduces gastric retention and reflux risk in post-stroke dysphagia patients compared to nasogastric tube feeding. When managing stroke patients with dysphagia, you now have evidence to consider intermittent oro-esophageal tube feeding as an alternative option to optimize gastrointestinal management.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心随机对照试验，样本量相对较小（54 名参与者），结果需要多中心大样本研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center randomized controlled trial with a relatively small sample size (54 participants), and its results require further validation by larger, multicenter studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Responsiveness of the Arabic version of the lower extremity functional scale in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders.
items.summary: The Arabic version of the Lower Extremity Functional Scale (LEFS) showed good responsiveness in 74 individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders, demonstrating significant correlations with other outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: LEFS 的阿拉伯语版在低肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中表现出良好的反应性，你可以将其纳入阿拉伯语患者群体的评估工具箱。
items.titleZh: 阿拉伯语版下肢功能量表在下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中的反应性研究
items.summaryZh: 阿拉伯语版下肢功能量表（LEFS）在 74 名下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中显示出良好的反应性，与其他结局指标有显著相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Arabic version of LEFS demonstrates good responsiveness in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders, making it a viable addition to your assessment toolkit for Arabic-speaking patients.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量为 74 名参与者，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study included 74 participants, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Adherence to exercise intervention including pain threshold, exercise and physiotherapy sessions for patients with chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy.
items.summary: This study investigated adherence to two pain threshold protocols during a 26-week exercise intervention for chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy in 84 patients, providing insights into patient compliance patterns.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性肩袖肌腱病患者，患者对26周运动干预中疼痛阈值方案的依从性，我们知之甚少。这项观察研究提示，理解依从性模式有助于你在长期运动方案中，更好地预判和调整治疗策略。
items.titleZh: 慢性肩袖肌腱病患者在包含疼痛阈值、运动和物理治疗的干预方案中的依从性研究
items.summaryZh: 本研究调查了 84 名慢性肩袖肌腱病患者在 26 周运动干预中对两种疼痛阈值方案的依从性，为患者依从性模式提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy, patient adherence to pain threshold protocols during a 26-week exercise intervention is a blind spot. This observational study suggests that understanding these adherence patterns can help you better anticipate and adjust treatment strategies in long-term exercise programs.
items.limitation: 本研究是 RCT 的次级数据分析，可能存在原始试验设计未完全覆盖本依从性研究需求的问题。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary data analysis of an RCT, which might have limitations regarding the original trial design not fully addressing the needs of this adherence study.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The Association of Depression, Anxiety, and Quality of Life with Sexual Function in Young-to-Middle-Aged Stroke Patients: A Case-Control Study.
items.summary: A case-control study of 30 stroke patients found significantly higher rates of sexual dysfunction (ASEX total scores: 19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001) and a significant decline in sexual satisfaction (7.5 to 4.1, p < 0.001) compared to controls, with associations to depression, anxiety, and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项病例对照研究强调了卒中患者性功能障碍的高患病率及其与抑郁、焦虑和生活质量的关联。在康复计划中，你应当更积极地评估和讨论卒中患者的性健康需求。
items.titleZh: 年轻至中年卒中患者抑郁、焦虑和生活质量与性功能的关系：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名卒中患者进行的病例对照研究发现，与对照组相比，卒中患者的性功能障碍发生率显著更高（ASEX 总分：19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001），性满意度显著下降（7.5 降至 4.1, p < 0.001），并与抑郁、焦虑及生活质量相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case-control study highlights the high prevalence of sexual dysfunction in stroke patients and its association with depression, anxiety, and quality of life. You should more proactively assess and discuss sexual health needs in stroke rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量相对较小（30 名卒中患者和 30 名对照），可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (30 stroke patients and 30 controls) may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Information and communication technologies in implementation strategies promoting allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and mapped various information and communication technologies (ICTs) used in implementation strategies to promote allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述识别了信息和通信技术（ICTs）在卒中后康复中辅助专职医疗人员遵循指南的潜力。你可以从中了解现有 ICT 工具的范围及其在改善指南依从性方面的应用，考虑在实践中进行整合。
items.titleZh: 信息和通信技术在促进专职医疗人员卒中后康复指南依从性实施策略中的应用：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并绘制了信息和通信技术（ICTs）在实施策略中，用于促进专职医疗人员在卒中后康复中遵守指南的应用情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review identifies the potential of Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) to support allied health professionals in adhering to guidelines for post-acute stroke care. You can use this to understand the range of existing ICT tools and their application in improving guideline adherence, and consider integrating them into your practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，主要侧重于识别和映射 ICTs 的应用，而非评估其干预效果的量化数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, primarily focused on identifying and mapping ICT applications rather than quantifying their intervention effects.

items.title: Correlation of Motor-Task Related Brain Activation Changes With Motor Performance Changes Induced by Constraint-Induced Therapy After Stroke.
items.summary: In 42 hemiparetic stroke participants, fMRI revealed changes in motor-task related brain activation correlated with functional recovery (Wolf Motor Function Test) after Constraint-Induced Movement Therapy (CIMT) during subacute and chronic periods.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了卒中后约束诱导运动疗法（CIMT）导致运动任务相关脑激活变化与运动功能恢复之间关系的神经影像学证据。你可以将这些发现作为理解 CIMT 机制的背景信息，但在临床实践上，仍应以 CIMT 的行为学证据为主。
items.titleZh: 卒中后约束诱导疗法引起的运动任务相关脑激活变化与运动表现变化的相关性
items.summaryZh: 在 42 名偏瘫卒中患者中，fMRI 显示，亚急性期和慢性期约束诱导运动疗法（CIMT）后，运动任务相关的脑激活变化与运动功能恢复（Wolf 运动功能测试）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides neuroimaging evidence on the relationship between motor-task related brain activation changes and motor performance recovery induced by Constraint-Induced Movement Therapy (CIMT) after stroke. You can use these findings as background to understand CIMT mechanisms, but clinical practice should still prioritize behavioral evidence of CIMT.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 42 名，且集中在亚急性期和慢性期，结果可能无法直接推广到所有卒中患者。
items.limitationEn: The study included 42 participants, focusing on subacute and chronic phases, so the results may not be directly generalizable to all stroke patients.

items.title: Enhancing dynamic postural stability during gait in Parkinson's disease with textured insoles and auditory cue training: a randomized controlled trial study.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 27 Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn & Yahr stages 2.5-3) found that combining textured insoles with auditory cues significantly improved dynamic postural stability during gait compared to textured insoles alone or progressive walking training.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，在帕金森病患者中，结合纹理鞋垫和听觉提示的训练能比单独使用纹理鞋垫或普通步行训练更好地增强步态中的动态姿势稳定性。在处理帕金森病患者的步态和平衡障碍时，你可以考虑这种多模态干预作为更优方案。
items.titleZh: 纹理鞋垫与听觉提示训练在帕金森病患者中增强步态动态姿势稳定性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 27 名帕金森病患者（Hoehn & Yahr 2.5-3 期）进行的随机对照试验发现，结合纹理鞋垫和听觉提示的训练，与单独使用纹理鞋垫或渐进式步行训练相比，能显著改善步态中的动态姿势稳定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that training combining textured insoles and auditory cues enhances dynamic postural stability during gait in Parkinson's disease patients better than textured insoles alone or progressive walking training. For Parkinson's patients with gait and balance impairments, you can consider this multimodal intervention as a superior option.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（27 名参与者），且主要集中在 Hoehn & Yahr 2.5-3 期的患者，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (27 participants) and focused primarily on patients in Hoehn & Yahr stages 2.5-3, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Exploring facilitators and barriers to health behaviors in stroke survivors: a multi-perspective qualitative study of patients, families, and healthcare professionals.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Shanghai, China, conducted semi-structured interviews with 17 stroke survivors, 10 family caregivers, and 11 healthcare professionals, identifying facilitators and barriers to post-stroke health behaviors for secondary prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究提供了卒中幸存者、家属和医疗专业人员对二级预防健康行为促进和障碍的多视角见解。在制定个性化康复计划时，你可以借鉴这些发现来更好地理解患者及其家庭的需求和挑战。
items.titleZh: 探讨卒中幸存者健康行为的促进因素和障碍：一项多视角定性研究（患者、家属和医疗专业人员）
items.summaryZh: 一项在中国上海进行的定性研究，通过对 17 名卒中幸存者、10 名家庭照护者和 11 名医疗专业人员进行半结构化访谈，识别了卒中后二级预防健康行为的促进因素和障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study offers multi-perspective insights from stroke survivors, families, and healthcare professionals on facilitators and barriers to secondary prevention health behaviors. When creating individualized rehabilitation plans, you can use these findings to better understand patient and family needs and challenges.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果不具统计学代表性，主要提供深层理解而非普遍性结论。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size, is not statistically representative, and primarily offers in-depth understanding rather than generalizable conclusions.

items.title: Examination and treatment of the spine for upper extremity pain: a case series.
items.summary: This case series describes three patients with upper extremity pain who achieved significant improvements with spine mobilization or manipulation techniques, suggesting the spine as a potential source of symptoms even with atypical pain referral patterns.
items.curatedReason: 这个病例系列提示，上肢疼痛患者的脊柱功能障碍可能是症状来源。在评估上肢疼痛患者时，你应考虑全面检查脊柱，特别是当症状模式不典型时。
items.titleZh: 针对上肢疼痛的脊柱检查和治疗：一个病例系列
items.summaryZh: 本病例系列描述了三名上肢疼痛患者通过脊柱松动或手法治疗取得显著改善，提示即使疼痛模式不典型，脊柱也可能是症状的潜在来源。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests that spinal dysfunction may be a source of symptoms in patients with upper extremity pain. When evaluating patients with upper extremity pain, you should consider a comprehensive spinal examination, especially when symptom patterns are atypical.
items.limitation: 这是一个小样本的病例系列研究，证据等级较低，无法得出普遍性结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a small case series with a low level of evidence, making it impossible to draw generalizable conclusions.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 1
items.summary: The U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services estimates a 1-3% overall payment increase for physical therapy codes under the Calendar Year 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Proposed Rule.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 2027 年医保医师费用表提案对 PT 报销预估将有 1-3% 的整体增长。这意味着你的执业收入可能略有提升，值得密切关注最终政策。
items.titleZh: 2027 年 Medicare 医师费用表提案：物理治疗师需知（第一部分）
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）预计，根据2027日历年度医保医师费用表提案，物理治疗代码的整体支付将增加1-3%。
items.curatedReasonEn: The proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule in the U.S. estimates a 1-3% overall payment increase for PT codes. This means your practice income might see a slight boost, so closely monitor the final policy.

items.title: Fake podiatrist sentence to be served in the community
items.summary: A fake podiatrist in Australia was sentenced to community service, highlighting the importance of regulatory compliance in healthcare professions.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚一名假足病医师被判社区服刑。这提醒你必须确保你的执业资质合规，并警惕未经授权的“治疗师”对行业的声誉损害。这是执业伦理和监管的典型案例。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚假足病医师被判社区服刑
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚一名假足病医师被判社区服刑，凸显了医疗行业监管合规的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: A fake podiatrist in Australia was sentenced to community service. This is a stark reminder to ensure your practice credentials are compliant and to be vigilant against unauthorized "therapists" damaging the profession's reputation. This is a classic case of practice ethics and regulation.

items.title: ACCESS for Primary Care Providers and Referring Clinicians
items.summary: The CMS Innovation Center launched the ACCESS model, a 10-year pilot offering ongoing, technology-supported chronic care from Medicare-enrolled providers at low or no cost to patients.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 创新中心推出了 ACCESS 模式，旨在通过技术支持的慢性病护理，补充初级保健和转诊服务。这将为 PT 提供新的转诊机会和远程监测手段，你应了解如何整合到你的执业中。
items.titleZh: 面向初级保健提供者和转诊临床医师的ACCESS项目
items.summaryZh: CMS创新中心推出了ACCESS模式，这是一个为期10年的试点项目，由 Medicare 注册医疗服务提供者为患者提供持续的、技术支持的慢性护理，费用低廉或免费。
items.curatedReasonEn: The U.S. CMS Innovation Center has launched the ACCESS model, aiming to supplement primary care and referral services with technology-supported chronic care. This will open new referral opportunities and remote monitoring avenues for PTs; you should understand how to integrate this into your practice.

items.title: From mechanics to mobilization: a biomechanically-informed rehabilitation framework for cesarean-related scars
items.summary: This systematic review developed a biomechanically-informed rehabilitation framework for cesarean-related scars, integrating superficial and deep scar considerations.

items.summary: This review proposes a dynamic stress-recovery model integrating frailty, physiological reserve, and surgical resilience.

items.curatedReasonEn: This review on frailty, physiological reserve, and surgical resilience offers a new perspective for understanding the postoperative recovery potential of older patients from multiple dimensions.

items.title: Characterization of orthogeriatric care models and association with mortality and health-economic outcomes in patients with hip fractures: a retrospective cohort study from Germany

items.titleZh: 德国骨科老年护理模式的特征及其与髋部骨折患者死亡率和健康经济学结果的关联：一项回顾性队列研究

items.curatedReasonEn: For hip fracture patients, varying orthogeriatric care models indeed impact mortality and health-economic outcomes. items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, which may be subject to confounding factors.

items.curatedReasonEn: This 2017 paper describes a protocol for an observational study on return-to-sport criteria after ACL reconstruction. Understanding its study design helps you comprehend the evolution of subsequent research, but it doesn't provide intervention evidence itself.

items.title: Application of unilateral biportal endoscopy in lumbar spinal stenosis complicated with degenerative lumbar scoliosis and evaluation of postoperative lumbar spinal stability
items.summary: This research evaluated the clinical effectiveness of unilateral biportal endoscopy in treating lumbar spinal stenosis complicated with degenerative lumbar scoliosis and assessed postoperative lumbar spinal stability.

items.titleZh: 单侧双通道内窥镜在腰椎管狭窄合并退行性腰椎侧弯中的应用及术后腰椎稳定性评估

This research focuses on surgical techniques, offering limited direct clinical guidance for physical therapists.

items.title: Eccentric cycling for ACL-R rehabilitation: A masterclass.
items.summary: This masterclass review discusses the increasing implementation of eccentric training in ACL-R rehabilitation, highlighting potential benefits for quadriceps atrophy and strength when introduced progressively from approximately three weeks post-operation.
items.curatedReason: 偏心单车训练在 ACL-R 康复中的应用正在提前。理解它能改善股四头肌萎缩和力量不足的潜在机制，并考虑在早期康复中（术后 3 周起）谨慎引入，但务必个体化渐进。
items.titleZh: 偏心单车在 ACL 重建康复中的应用：大师班观点
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述探讨了偏心训练在 ACL 重建（ACL-R）康复中日益普遍的应用，强调从术后约三周开始逐步引入，可能对股四头肌萎缩和力量不足有潜在益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Eccentric cycling is being introduced earlier in ACL-R rehabilitation. Understand its potential mechanisms for improving quadriceps atrophy and strength deficits, and consider cautious, individualized, and progressive implementation in early rehabilitation (from 3 weeks post-op).
items.limitation: 这是一篇综述而非原始研究，具体效果和安全性需更多高质量 RCT 验证。
items.limitationEn: As a review, it synthesizes existing literature; specific effects and safety require further high-quality RCTs.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Spine-related leg pain: Definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management.
items.summary: This review clarifies definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management of spine-related leg pain (SRLP), distinguishing between radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain to improve diagnostic consistency.
items.curatedReason: 脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）的分类和诊断共识依然混乱，这篇综述能帮你梳理清楚神经根病、神经根痛和躯体牵涉痛的界限，有助于你更精准地诊断。
items.titleZh: 脊柱相关腿痛：定义、病因、临床表现与管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述阐明了脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）的定义、病因、临床表现和管理，区分了神经根病、神经根痛和躯体牵涉痛，旨在提高诊断一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The consensus on classification and diagnosis of spine-related leg pain (SRLP) remains elusive. This review helps clarify the distinctions between radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain, facilitating more precise diagnoses.
items.limitation: 本综述是叙述性总结，未提供量化证据合成。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review provides a descriptive summary and does not include quantitative evidence synthesis.

items.title: Perspectives of Private Practice Physical Therapy Health Care Systems Participating in a Pragmatic Clinical Trial: A Qualitative Study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the perspectives of four private practice physical therapy health care systems participating in a pragmatic clinical trial, highlighting challenges and benefits of research involvement in non-academic settings.
items.curatedReason: 如果你是私立诊所运营者或研究员，这篇定性研究揭示了私立物理治疗机构参与临床试验的挑战和收益，为你未来合作提供借鉴。
items.titleZh: 私立物理治疗医疗系统参与实用临床试验的视角：一项定性研究

items.curatedReasonEn: If you are a private practice owner or a researcher, this qualitative study sheds light on the challenges and benefits of private physical therapy practices participating in clinical trials, offering insights for future collaborations.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，仅代表 4 个私立机构的经验，普适性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, representing the experiences of only four private practices, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Beyond "Biomedical-Plus": Reclaiming the biopsychosocial model in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: This article argues that musculoskeletal physiotherapists can move towards a more authentic application of the biopsychosocial (BPS) model by focusing on three interconnected foundational conditions: professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication, to counter the current "biomedical-plus" approach.
items.curatedReason: 生物心理社会模型常被肌肉骨骼物理治疗师简化为“生物医学+”模式。这篇文章直接指出，你需要重审并深入采纳模型核心的“三C”要素：专业自信（Confidence）、角色清晰（Clarity）和同情沟通（Compassionate communication），以更全面地整合情感、关系和社会维度到临床实践中。
items.titleZh: 超越“生物医学+”：肌肉骨骼物理治疗中生物心理社会模型的回归
items.summaryZh: 本文指出，在肌肉骨骼物理治疗中，生物心理社会（BPS）模型常被简化为“生物医学+”的实践。作者认为，物理治疗师可以通过提升专业自信、明确角色定位和运用同情沟通，实现BPS模型的更真实应用，从而更好地整合情感、关系和社会维度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The biopsychosocial model is often simplified to a 'biomedical-plus' approach by MSK physiotherapists. This article directly argues you need to re-evaluate and deeply adopt the model's core '3Cs'—professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication—to more comprehensively integrate emotional, relational, and social dimensions into clinical practice.

items.title: Effectiveness of Combined Biopsychosocial Interventions for Chronic Low Back Pain: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated combined biopsychosocial interventions for chronic low back pain, finding them effective in reducing pain and functional disability in adults (≥18 years) compared to usual care, waiting-list controls, and active unimodal interventions.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析强化了生物心理社会联合干预对慢性腰痛患者的有效性。在与常规治疗、等待观察或单一干预方案相比时，优先考虑多模式的生物心理社会方法，尤其是整合了运动治疗、疼痛教育和心理策略的方案。
items.titleZh: 生物心理社会联合干预对慢性腰痛疗效的系统综述与随机对照试验荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了生物心理社会联合干预对慢性腰痛的疗效。研究发现，结合运动治疗、疼痛教育和心理策略的干预方案在减轻成人（≥18岁）慢性腰痛患者的疼痛和功能障碍方面，优于常规治疗、等待观察或单一干预。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis reinforces the effectiveness of multimodal biopsychosocial interventions for chronic low back pain. Compared to usual care, waiting list controls, or unimodal interventions, prioritize approaches integrating exercise therapy, pain education, and psychological strategies; they effectively reduce pain and improve functional disability.
items.limitation: 研究结论的普适性可能受限于纳入研究的异质性和干预方案的具体组成。
items.limitationEn: The generalizability of the findings might be limited by the heterogeneity of included studies and specific intervention compositions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Comparative efficacy of different joint mobilization techniques in shoulder adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis compared the clinical effects of different non-thrust joint mobilization approaches on objective and subjective outcomes in individuals with shoulder adhesive capsulitis, based on English-language RCTs published between 2000 and 2025.
items.curatedReason: 对于肩关节粘连性囊炎，非冲撞性关节松动术是一个基石干预，但不同手法间的疗效差异此前并不明确。这项荟萃分析将帮助你理解不同关节松动术在缓解疼痛和改善活动度方面的相对优势，从而优化你的临床决策。
items.titleZh: 不同关节松动技术对肩关节粘连性囊炎疗效的比较：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析比较了2000年至2025年间发表的英文随机对照试验中，不同非冲撞性关节松动术对肩关节粘连性囊炎患者客观和主观结局的临床效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: For shoulder adhesive capsulitis, non-thrust joint mobilization is a cornerstone intervention. This meta-analysis helps you clarify the relative advantages of different mobilization techniques in pain relief and range of motion improvement, optimizing your clinical decisions. Notably, this is based on English-language RCTs published between 2000 and 2025.
items.limitation: 纳入研究可能存在异质性，影响了不同松动技术之间直接比较的精确性。
items.limitationEn: Potential heterogeneity among included studies may affect the precision of direct comparisons between different mobilization techniques.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Outpatient rehabilitation can prevent suicide after acquired brain injury.
items.summary: A registry study (n=591 treated, n=2,932 controls) supplemented with medical record reviews found that outpatient rehabilitation programs for adults with acquired brain injuries (ABI) were associated with a lower frequency of suicides compared to a matched control group, suggesting a preventive role.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了重要的观察性证据，表明获得性脑损伤（ABI）患者的门诊康复可能降低自杀发生率。考虑到ABI患者自杀率高于普通人群，这一发现强调了康复服务在整体患者管理中的关键作用，别低估你在患者心理健康维护中的价值。
items.titleZh: 门诊康复可预防获得性脑损伤后的自杀
items.summaryZh: 一项登记研究（治疗组n=591，对照组n=2932），辅以病历回顾，发现接受门诊康复项目的获得性脑损伤（ABI）成人患者，其自杀发生率低于匹配的对照组，提示门诊康复在预防ABI患者自杀中可能发挥作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers important observational evidence suggesting that outpatient rehabilitation may reduce suicide rates among patients with acquired brain injury (ABI). Given that ABI patients have a higher suicide rate than the general population, this finding underscores the critical role of rehabilitation services in overall patient management; don't underestimate your value in maintaining patients' mental health.
items.limitation: 观察性研究可能存在混杂因素，无法完全排除其他未测量变量对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: Observational studies may have confounding factors, and cannot fully exclude the influence of other unmeasured variables on the results.

items.title: Exploring equity in telehealth interventions in physiotherapy: A meta-epidemiological study.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological study (n=94 trials) assessed equity in telehealth interventions in physiotherapy research using the PROGRESS Plus framework, finding that most studies did not adequately report or focus on equity factors.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃流行病学研究评估了物理治疗远程医疗干预的公平性，并指出大多数研究未能充分报告或关注PROGRESS Plus框架中的公平性因素。这提醒你，在设计和实施远程医疗项目时，必须积极考虑社会经济、地理和教育等因素，以确保服务的可及性和公平性，别让技术成为新的屏障。
items.titleZh: 探索物理治疗远程医疗干预中的公平性：一项荟萃流行病学研究
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃流行病学研究（纳入94项试验）使用PROGRESS Plus框架评估了物理治疗远程医疗干预研究中的公平性，发现大多数研究未能充分报告或关注公平性因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-epidemiological study assessed equity in telerehabilitation interventions for physiotherapy, highlighting that most studies fail to adequately report or focus on equity factors within the PROGRESS Plus framework. This reminds you to actively consider socioeconomic, geographic, and educational factors when designing and implementing telerehabilitation programs to ensure accessibility and equity, and prevent technology from becoming a new barrier.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于2020年至2023年的已发表RCT，可能未能捕捉到更广泛时间范围或非RCT设计的远程医疗实践的公平性特征。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to RCTs published between 2020 and 2023, and may not capture equity characteristics of telerehabilitation practices in a broader timeframe or with non-RCT designs.

items.title: Digital Addiction and Body Balance: An Investigation of Postural Stability in Young Adults: A Cross-Sectional Study.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study (n=74) investigated postural balance performance in young adults, finding that those with smartphone addiction showed impaired balance, especially when performing attention-demanding tasks, highlighting the impact of digital device use on postural stability.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究提示，过度使用数字设备与年轻人姿势稳定性受损有关，尤其是在执行注意力任务时。这提醒你在评估和治疗年轻患者的平衡问题时，别忘了把数字设备使用情况纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 数字成瘾与身体平衡：一项针对年轻成人姿势稳定性的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究（n=74）旨在探讨数字成瘾对年轻成人姿势平衡的影响，发现有智能手机成瘾的年轻人在姿势平衡表现上较差，尤其是在需要注意力分散的任务中，提示数字成瘾与姿势稳定性受损相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study suggests that excessive digital device use is linked to impaired postural stability in young adults, especially during attention-demanding tasks. This highlights the importance of considering digital device habits when assessing and treating balance issues in young patients.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且人群仅限于特定大学的学生。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and the population was limited to students from a specific university.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Assessment and Management Practices for Post-Stroke Shoulder Pain Among Rehabilitation Professionals in Vietnam: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey investigated current assessment and management practices for post-stroke shoulder pain among rehabilitation professionals in 14 Vietnamese hospitals, identifying potential evidence-practice gaps and barriers to effective care.
items.curatedReason: 这项越南的调查揭示了卒中后肩痛评估和管理实践中存在的潜在差距和障碍，尤其是在中低收入国家。这提醒你，在将循证实践应用于不同文化和资源受限的环境时，需要进行本地化调整和考量。
items.titleZh: 越南康复专业人员卒中后肩痛评估与管理实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面调查研究了越南14家医院康复专业人员在卒中后肩痛评估和管理方面的现有实践，旨在识别潜在的证据与实践差距以及有效护理的障碍。
items.limitation: 研究为横断面调查，仅反映特定地区和时间的实践情况，无法评估干预效果或长期趋势。
items.limitationEn: The study is a cross-sectional survey, reflecting practices only in a specific region and time, and cannot assess intervention effectiveness or long-term trends.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Advancing spine connectomics and neural integration through machine learning and neuroengineering: a narrative review.
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes recent advances in spinal connectomics and neural integration, examining how machine learning and neuroengineering are shifting understanding of the spinal cord from a simple reflex relay toward an active system contributing to sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述概述了脊髓连接组学在理解脊髓功能上的最新进展，如何从简单的反射通路演变为主动的感觉运动整合系统。了解这些基础神经科学进展有助于你更深层地理解脊髓损伤的神经生理学，虽然它不会直接改变你的临床干预，但拓宽了你对潜在治疗靶点的认知。
items.titleZh: 通过机器学习和神经工程学推进脊髓连接组学和神经整合：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了脊髓连接组学和神经整合的最新进展，探讨了机器学习和神经工程学如何将脊髓的理解从简单的反射通路转变为一个有助于感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制的活跃系统。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review outlines recent advances in spinal connectomics, highlighting that the spinal cord is not just a simple reflex relay, but an active system for sensorimotor integration. While it won't directly alter your clinical interventions, it broadens your understanding of spinal cord injury neurophysiology and potential therapeutic targets.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: The Combined Use of Non-Invasive Neurostimulation with Interactive Digital Technologies in Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped the empirical evidence (494 unique records identified) regarding the combined use of non-invasive neurostimulation with interactive digital technologies in spinal cord injury rehabilitation, identifying original clinical data from individuals with SCI.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述描绘了非侵入性神经刺激与互动数字技术在脊髓损伤康复中结合应用的证据图谱。它有助于你快速了解当前研究的重点和空白，并理解这种组合疗法在临床实践中的潜力与局限性。
items.titleZh: 非侵入性神经刺激与互动数字技术在脊髓损伤康复中联合应用的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统地绘制了非侵入性神经刺激与互动数字技术相结合在脊髓损伤康复中的经验证据图谱，识别出494条相关记录，并筛选出报告脊髓损伤患者原创临床数据的研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review maps the evidence for combining non-invasive neurostimulation with interactive digital technologies in spinal cord injury rehabilitation. It helps you quickly grasp current research foci and gaps, and understand the potential and limitations of this combined therapy in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 范围综述侧重于证据图谱而非干预效果评估，因此无法提供明确的临床行动建议。
items.limitationEn: The scoping review focuses on mapping evidence rather than evaluating intervention efficacy, so it cannot provide clear clinical action recommendations.

items.title: Effects of multimodal balance training with and without auditory cues on balance, gait mobility, risk of fall and quality of life in patients with chronic stroke
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (n=42) found that multimodal balance training with auditory cues improved balance, gait mobility, fall risk, and quality of life in chronic stroke survivors aged 45-70 years, compared to training without cues.
items.curatedReason: 这项小型RCT提示，卒中后患者的多模式平衡训练结合听觉线索，可能在改善平衡、步态移动性、跌倒风险和生活质量方面带来额外益处。在为慢性卒中患者设计平衡训练时，可以考虑整合听觉线索以优化效果。
items.titleZh: 多模式平衡训练结合或不结合听觉线索对慢性卒中患者平衡、步态移动性、跌倒风险和生活质量的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=42）发现，对于45-70岁的慢性卒中幸存者，结合听觉线索的多模式平衡训练在改善平衡、步态移动性、跌倒风险和生活质量方面，优于不结合听觉线索的训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small RCT suggests that multimodal balance training combined with auditory cues may offer additional benefits in improving balance, gait mobility, fall risk, and quality of life in post-stroke patients. When designing balance training for chronic stroke patients, consider integrating auditory cues to optimize outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=42），且为单中心设计，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=42) and is single-center, limiting the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Factors Explaining Limited Daily Hand-use in Individuals with Fair-Good Motor Ability Post-Stroke.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigated factors explaining limited daily hand-use in individuals post-stroke with fair-to-good upper extremity motor ability (Fugl-Meyer Assessment >30/66), identifying proprioception, executive functions, self-efficacy, and upper extremity dual-task capacity as key contributors.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后患者即使上肢运动能力良好（Fugl-Meyer Assessment >30/66），日常手部使用仍可能受限。这项研究提示你，评估时需综合考虑本体感觉、执行功能、自我效能和上肢双任务能力，这些是非运动障碍的关键因素，别只盯着肌肉力量和运动控制。
items.titleZh: 卒中后手部运动能力良好患者日常手部使用受限的解释因素
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究旨在识别卒中后上肢运动能力（Fugl-Meyer 评估 >30/66）良好但日常手部使用仍受限的解释因素，发现本体感觉、执行功能、自我效能和上肢双任务能力是关键贡献者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Even with fair-to-good upper extremity motor ability (Fugl-Meyer Assessment >30/66) post-stroke, daily hand use can remain limited. This study suggests you must comprehensively consider proprioception, executive functions, self-efficacy, and upper extremity dual-task capacity during assessment; these are key non-motor contributors, so don't focus solely on muscle strength and motor control.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法建立各因素与手部使用受限之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing a causal relationship between factors and limited hand use.

items.title: Lifestyle medicine innovations: Physical activity assessment in patient care and implementation of a digital health platform to support healthier movement.
items.summary: This narrative review introduces the ExerciseRxTM digital health platform as a scalable approach to support personalized physical activity and home exercise within clinical care, integrating Physical Activity Vital Sign (PAVS) into an academic healthcare system.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述介绍了 ExerciseRxTM 数字健康平台及其在临床护理中支持个性化体育活动和家庭锻炼的方法。它提示你关注数字健康工具在物理治疗中的应用潜力，特别是在提高患者依从性和可扩展性方面。
items.titleZh: 生活方式医学创新：患者护理中的体育活动评估与数字健康平台实施以支持更健康运动
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述介绍了ExerciseRxTM数字健康平台，该平台作为一种可扩展的方法，旨在支持临床护理中的个性化体育活动和家庭锻炼，并将体育活动生命体征（PAVS）整合到学术医疗系统中。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review introduces the ExerciseRxTM digital health platform and its approach to supporting personalized physical activity and home exercise in clinical care. It prompts you to consider the potential of digital health tools in physical therapy, particularly for improving patient adherence and scalability.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Prediction of Exercise Intolerance in the Recovery Period After Cardiovascular Surgery Using Perioperative Clinical Parameters.
items.summary: This retrospective cohort study (N=590) developed and validated a machine learning model using perioperative clinical parameters to predict reduced exercise capacity at 3 months post-cardiovascular surgery in patients aged ≤75 years.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究开发并验证了一个机器学习模型，用于预测心血管手术后患者3个月的运动能力。这提示你，未来我们可以利用围手术期临床参数更早识别高风险患者，从而更精准地制定心肺康复计划。
items.titleZh: 利用围手术期临床参数预测心血管手术后恢复期运动不耐受
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性队列研究（N=590）开发并验证了一个机器学习模型，该模型使用围手术期临床参数来预测75岁以下心血管手术患者术后3个月的运动能力下降情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and validated a machine learning model to predict exercise capacity at 3 months post-cardiovascular surgery. This suggests that in the future, we can use perioperative clinical parameters to identify high-risk patients earlier, thereby enabling more precise cardiopulmonary rehabilitation planning.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，模型的外推性和普适性可能受限于数据来源。
items.limitationEn: The study is a single-center retrospective cohort study, and the generalizability of the model may be limited by the data source.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: APTA Members Unite to Advance Payment Advocacy Via New SPARC Forum and Pledge
items.summary: APTA has launched the SPARC Forum and the APTA Payment Advocacy Pledge to empower members in driving meaningful payment reform and strengthening the future of the physical therapy profession, especially regarding payer advocacy in states.
items.curatedReason: APTA推出SPARC论坛和支付倡导承诺，旨在推动支付改革，加强物理治疗师服务。积极参与此类倡导活动，是提升物理治疗行业地位和保障合理报销的关键。
items.titleZh: APTA成员团结起来，通过新的SPARC论坛和承诺推进支付倡导
items.summaryZh: APTA推出了SPARC论坛和APTA支付倡导承诺，旨在赋能成员推动有意义的支付改革，并加强物理治疗专业，尤其是在各州的支付方倡导方面。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA launched the SPARC Forum and Payment Advocacy Pledge to drive payment reform and strengthen physical therapist services. Actively participating in such advocacy is key to elevating the PT profession and ensuring fair reimbursement.

items.title: Dry Needling State Laws
items.summary: APTA provides an updated infographic (as of April 2026) detailing state laws on dry needling practice by physical therapists in the US, highlighting which states allow, prohibit, or have no specific provisions.
items.curatedReason: APTA提供了各州干针执业法律的最新概况（截至2026年4月）。你在美国执业干针时，务必查阅你所在州的具体法律，确保合规操作。
items.titleZh: 干针执业州法律
items.summaryZh: APTA提供了一份更新至2026年4月的图表，详细说明了美国各州关于物理治疗师干针执业的法律，明确了哪些州允许、禁止或没有具体规定。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA provides an updated overview of state laws on dry needling practice (as of April 2026). When practicing dry needling in the US, you must consult your state's specific laws to ensure compliant operation.

items.title: Let's talk about sex (and gender) after ACL injury: a ...
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis investigated sex and gender differences in self-reported activity and knee-related outcomes after ACL injury, showing distinct patterns between males and females.
items.curatedReason: ACL损伤后，男性和女性在自报活动量和膝关节结局上存在显著差异。你在制定康复方案时，必须考虑这些性别因素，尤其是女性在重返运动和功能结局方面可能面临独特挑战。
items.titleZh: 让我们谈谈ACL损伤后的性别问题：一项关于自报活动和膝关节相关结局的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析探讨了ACL损伤后自报活动量和膝关节相关结局的性别差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Significant sex differences exist in self-reported activity and knee-related outcomes following ACL injury. You must account for these sex-specific factors when developing rehabilitation plans, as females, in particular, may face unique challenges in returning to sport and achieving functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是自报结局，可能存在回忆偏差。
items.limitationEn: The study focuses on self-reported outcomes, which may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: Action observation therapy in pediatric cerebral palsy: an ...
items.summary: An fNIRS-based randomized controlled trial investigated the cortical responses and balance improvements from Action Observation Therapy (AOT) in pediatric cerebral palsy patients, a group of neurodevelopmental disorders affecting movement and posture.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT探索了儿童脑瘫患者行动观察疗法（AOT）对皮层反应和平衡的影响。如果你在实践中应用AOT，这项研究提供了初步的神经生理学和临床证据。
items.titleZh: 儿童脑瘫行动观察疗法：基于fNIRS的皮层反应和平衡研究——一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项基于fNIRS的随机对照试验研究了儿童脑瘫患者行动观察疗法（AOT）对皮层反应和平衡的影响。脑瘫是一组影响运动和姿势的神经发育障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT explores the effects of action observation therapy (AOT) on cortical responses and balance in pediatric cerebral palsy patients. If you apply AOT in practice, this study provides preliminary neurophysiological and clinical evidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步随机对照试验，可能样本量较小，需更大型研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial, likely with a small sample size, and requires validation by larger studies.

items.title: Handgrip and leg strength and risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged ≥ 80 years: a prospective HUNT study
items.summary: A prospective HUNT study examined handgrip and leg strength and the risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged ≥80 years, a population underrepresented in fall research, finding reduced muscle strength as a recognized risk factor for falls.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究量化了80岁及以上老年人的握力、腿部力量与严重跌倒伤害风险之间的关系。在评估老年患者跌倒风险时，应特别关注其肌肉力量指标。
items.titleZh: 80岁及以上老年人握力、腿部力量与严重跌倒伤害风险：一项前瞻性HUNT研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性HUNT研究调查了80岁及以上老年人的握力、腿部力量与严重跌倒伤害风险之间的关系。该年龄组在跌倒研究中代表性不足，研究发现肌肉力量减弱是公认的跌倒风险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study quantifies the relationship between handgrip and leg strength and the risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged 80 and above. When assessing fall risk in elderly patients, you should pay particular attention to their muscle strength indicators.
items.limitation: 研究未明确是否控制了所有潜在混杂因素，可能存在残余混杂。
items.limitationEn: The study does not specify whether all potential confounding factors were controlled for, and residual confounding may exist.

items.title: Frailty in patients undergoing video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery for lung cancer: a narrative review of assessment, outcomes and prehabilitation
items.summary: A narrative review summarizes frailty assessment, outcomes, and prehabilitation in patients undergoing video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) for lung cancer, noting that older adults are increasingly considered for such procedures.
items.curatedReason: 对于肺癌胸腔镜手术患者，虚弱评估应是术前康复的关键环节。请务必在术前识别虚弱个体，并根据这篇综述的建议，制定个性化的预康复方案以优化术后恢复。
items.titleZh: 肺癌胸腔镜手术患者的虚弱评估、结局和术前康复：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述总结了肺癌胸腔镜手术（VATS）患者的虚弱评估、结局和术前康复，指出老年人越来越多地被考虑进行此类手术。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients undergoing VATS for lung cancer, frailty assessment must be a critical component of prehabilitation. Ensure you identify frail individuals pre-operatively and, as this review suggests, develop personalized prehabilitation programs to optimize post-operative recovery.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，未提供量化证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may have selection bias and does not provide quantified evidence.

items.title: Development and validation of the pulmonary rehabilitation Kinesiophobia scale for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
items.summary: This study developed and validated the Pulmonary Rehabilitation Kinesiophobia Scale for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in China, as kinesiophobia is a significant barrier to pulmonary rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究开发并验证了COPD患者肺康复运动恐惧症量表。如果你在临床中遇到COPD患者对运动有恐惧，可以使用这个新工具进行评估。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者肺康复运动恐惧症量表的开发与验证
items.summaryZh: 本研究开发并验证了用于中国慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者的肺康复运动恐惧症量表，运动恐惧症是肺康复的一个重要障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and validated the Pulmonary Rehabilitation Kinesiophobia Scale for patients with COPD. If you encounter COPD patients with kinesiophobia in your practice, you can use this new tool for assessment.
items.limitation: 量表在中国COPD患者中开发和验证，其跨文化适用性尚待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The scale was developed and validated in Chinese COPD patients, and its cross-cultural applicability needs further validation.
